materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/PDF/OA package, local XLSX/TIF supplementary assets, and linked database snapshots were sufficient for worker-4/6 source review. No blocking owner-layer material gap remains.

adjudication_summary: Worker-4/6 re-review of the piscidin paper closed the previous framework-test gap: Table 3 E. coli assay rows and Table 4 Tetrahymena rows were re-anchored to primary source locators, DRAMP no-MIC metadata conflicts were preserved as cautions, and the final mechanism record now distinguishes phenotypic antibacterial/protozoal activity from direct SB P7 Tetrahymena membrane-disruption evidence.

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Packet material remains material_extracted_with_gaps because it is a bounded extraction packet, but all owner-layer sources relevant to this ticket were reopened: XML/PDF, OA package members, local XLSX/TIF supplements, locator index, and linked database snapshots.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Structural packet/final artifacts are present; validator readiness is treated as a prerequisite only, not as publication-grade proof.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay rows now have primary Table 3/4 locators; DRAMP no-MIC metadata rows remain explicit source_conflict cautions because the database row lacks a quantitative MIC target to reconcile.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 Table 3 rows were preserved, and worker-6 final adjudication added Table 4 PCmin/PC100 Tetrahymena rows because they are locally supported and directly relevant to database/mechanism review.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Final mechanism claims are bounded to phenotypic antibacterial/antiprotozoal activity plus direct microscopy-supported SB P7 Tetrahymena membrane disruption; no bacterial molecular target is inferred.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: The previous blocking ticket is closed; remaining database/source differences are caution-bearing, source-located, and nonblocking.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Twenty-seven DRAMP metadata rows for DRAMP18438-DRAMP18440 say no MICs were found; XML/PDF Tables 2-4 support piscidin context but not a row-specific DRAMP MIC value, so these remain source_conflict cautions.
MIC/MBC and PCmin/PC100 endpoints are phenotypic. Only the SB P7 Tetrahymena microscopy figure is promoted to direct membrane-disruption mechanism evidence.
Primary XML/PDF gives accession numbers and figure-based predicted amino-acid context; this repair does not normalize database sequence strings beyond source-located identity/activity reconciliation.
